_comment: Source: BerriAI/litellm PRs #40655, #40599, and #40608. Uses the Geist fonts, brand tokens, and HTML renderer from BerriAI/litellm-internal-skills PR #86 at 1fea7d4dc630f011fd9a3282c657ca4c39bd1366. To regenerate, copy hero.html into that skill's templates/blog directory, then run node scripts/render.mjs templates/blog/hero.html /path/to/hero.png --theme dark --transparent. Run the output through plugins/optimize-images.js in litellm-docs. The relative brand.css link resolves inside that skill. The HTML contains the diagram labels; this file records provenance and the render command.
